import collections
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data_dict):
    """
    Analyze whether category counts form a uniform distribution and plot the counts.
    """
    if not data_dict:
        return None, "The distribution is uniform."

    ordered_items = list(collections.OrderedDict(data_dict).items())
    categories = [k for k, _ in ordered_items]
    counts = np.asarray([v for _, v in ordered_items], dtype=float)

    avg_count = float(np.mean(counts))
    is_uniform = np.all(np.abs(counts - avg_count) <= 1e-5)
    message = "The distribution is uniform." if is_uniform else "The distribution is not uniform."

    unique_count = len(np.unique(counts))
    bins = max(1, min(10, unique_count))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(counts, bins=bins, edgecolor="black")
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(categories)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(categories, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Category")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.set_title("Distribution of category counts")
    fig.tight_layout()

    return ax, message
